name: transformers
description: 🤗 Transformers: the model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning models in text, vision, audio, and multimodal models, for both inference and training.
one_liner: A free library that lets developers download and run thousands of pre-trained AI models for text, images, and audio instead of training from scratch.
buyer: A startup founder who wants to add an AI feature (summarization, image tagging, transcription) to their product without hiring a machine-learning team.
business_use_cases: A customer-support SaaS uses it to add automatic ticket summarization without building a model from scratch.
A media company uses it to auto-transcribe and tag audio/video archives for search.
A niche industry app (legal, medical) fine-tunes an open model from this library for domain-specific document classification.

money_ideas.idea: Fine-tune an open model for one narrow industry task and sell access via API.
Offer 'add AI to your SaaS' integration consulting using pre-trained models from this library.

steal_this: Pick one tedious task a local business does by hand (tagging photos, summarizing reviews) and ship a tiny app this weekend using an off-the-shelf model from here.
